/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/chest-p.description: The Chest Press is the single-user version of our outdoor pressing machine: one orange seat, a backrest and two handles at chest height. The user sits, pushes the handles away and controls them on the way back, using body weight as the resistance. It is a simple first strength machine for a small society gym or a school campus. It pairs well with a leg machine so users can train upper and lower body in one visit. The Chest Press comes in Play Orange; we share its size and warranty terms with the quote. For the Chest Press, we will confirm cover in the quote; our usual terms are 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings. Ask us where it fits on your plan.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/chest-p.spec_paragraph: A single-station machine like this can usually be installed self-standing on a firm base, or grouted if the soil is soft. The pivots under the handles are the parts that wear, so check them and the seat bolts during maintenance. Keep a clear zone in front of the handles.
flags: No spec rows, dimensions or warranty in the fact sheet.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/cross-f.description: Cross Fit is a frame built for bodyweight training, with monkey bars, pull-up bars and several exercise stations on one structure. Users can hang and travel along the monkey bars, do pull-ups at different heights and use the other stations for push and core work. It suits younger, stronger users such as college students, sports clubs and corporate fitness groups, and it gives a society gym a training area that feels different from the usual machines. Cross Fit comes in Play Orange as part of our Fun Fitness range. Ask us for the station list and a drawing before you plan the space. Our standard terms cover galvanised pipes for 3 years, and the warranty for Cross Fit will be confirmed in your quote.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/cross-f.spec_paragraph: Users hang from the bars and drop to the ground, so lay rubber flooring under the whole frame rather than just around it. Cross Fit is normally grouted because of the hanging loads. With no bearings in a bar frame, maintenance is mainly checking bolts, welds and the grip surface of the bars.
flags: No spec rows, dimensions, warranty or list of stations in the fact sheet.
'Cross Fit' / 'CrossFit' is a registered trademark of CrossFit LLC. Consider renaming.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/fun-cyc.description: The Fun Cycle is an outdoor exercise cycle with an orange seat and an orange steering wheel. The user pedals in a seated position, which gives a steady leg and cardio workout without the impact of running. Older residents often like it because it feels familiar, and it suits people who walk in the park and want a few minutes of sitting exercise in between. It is finished in Play Orange as part of our Fun Fitness range for parks, societies and walking tracks. The measured drawing and warranty terms are sent with each quote. We will confirm both for the Fun Cycle in your quote, with our standard terms of 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings. Send us your open gym plan and we will add it.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/fun-cyc.spec_paragraph: Pedals and cranks turn on bearings, so they need checking and greasing at each service, especially after the rains. The Fun Cycle frame can be bolted self-standing or grouted. Place the cycle where the pedals cannot catch anyone walking past, and keep the seat dry and clean.
flags: No spec rows, dimensions or warranty in the fact sheet.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/fun-rid.description: The Fun Rider is a horse-rider machine with an orange seat and handlebar. The user sits, pushes with the feet and pulls the handlebar at the same time, rising and lowering in a rowing-like motion. It works the arms, back and legs together, so one machine covers a lot of the body. Users of most ages can manage it because they set their own pace. The Fun Rider comes in Play Orange and belongs to our Fun Fitness outdoor gym range. We share the exact footprint and warranty terms with every quote. Our sales team will confirm the Fun Rider's warranty; our standard cover is 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings and spare parts. Ask us to include it in your park or society layout.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/fun-rid.spec_paragraph: The Fun Rider has several linked pivots between the seat, footrests and handlebar, so check each joint and bearing for looseness at every service. Installation is self-standing or grouted, chosen after we see your ground. Keep space behind the seat clear, because the seat arm moves as the user rides.
flags: No spec rows, dimensions or warranty in the fact sheet.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/fun-row.description: The Fun Rower copies a rowing action outdoors, with an orange seat and footrests. The user sits, braces the feet and pulls the handles towards the chest, then lets them go back, working the back, arms and legs in one smooth movement. Because it is seated and steady, it suits a wide group, from office staff on a campus to retired residents in a society. It is finished in Play Orange as part of our Fun Fitness range. Ask our sales team for its footprint and warranty terms before you plan the layout. For the Fun Rower, the warranty will be confirmed with your quote; our usual terms cover galvanised pipes for 3 years and bearings for 1 year. Ask us for a layout that groups it with other machines.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/fun-row.spec_paragraph: The rowing arm moves on pivots, which are the parts to inspect and grease. The Fun Rower can be self-standing or grouted. Set it on a level base so the seat sits square, and leave room at the front where the handles travel.
flags: No spec rows, dimensions or warranty in the fact sheet.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/fun-wal.description: The Fun Walker Double is an air walker for two people. Each user stands on an orange foot pedal and swings the legs forward and back in a walking motion while holding the frame. It gives a low-impact cardio workout that is easy on the knees. That makes it one of the first machines we suggest for a park, a walking track or a senior citizens' area. With two walkers on one frame, friends or couples can exercise side by side. Its footprint and warranty terms come with your quotation. On the Fun Walker Double, our standard terms would give 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings, and we will confirm this in writing. Tell us how many walkers your track gets in the morning and we will suggest a mix.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/fun-wal.spec_paragraph: Air walkers swing on bearings at the top of each pedal arm, so these need regular checks for noise and play. We set the double frame self-standing or grouted. Leave clear space in front of and behind the pedals, because the swing reaches further than people expect.
flags: No spec rows, dimensions or warranty in the fact sheet.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/fun-wal.description: The Fun Walker Single is our one-person air walker, with orange foot pedals hung from a frame and handles to hold. The user swings the legs in a long walking stride without the feet touching the ground, a smooth, low-impact movement. A single unit fits small spaces such as a society terrace, a hospital garden or the corner of a school ground, where a double frame would crowd the area. Like most of our Fun Fitness machines it is finished in Play Orange, though its size is not yet listed. Our team will confirm cover for the Fun Walker Single; under our standard terms, galvanised pipes carry 3 years and bearings 1 year. Send us a photo of the space and we will check the fit.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/fun-wal.spec_paragraph: On a single air walker, the two pedal arms and their bearings take all the movement. Inspect them during maintenance and grease if they start to squeak. A single walker is light enough to go in self-standing on firm ground, or grouted on soft soil. Keep the swing area in front and behind free of planters and benches.
flags: No spec rows, dimensions or warranty in the fact sheet.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/leg-ext.description: The Leg Extension is a seated station in Ocean Grey for strengthening the front of the thighs. The user sits, hooks the feet behind a pad and straightens the legs, then lowers them under control. Older users like it for building leg strength for stairs. It fits well beside an air walker in a park or society gym. It belongs to our Fun Fitness range. Exact dimensions and warranty terms are shared with the layout drawing. Our sales team will confirm the Leg Extension's warranty; our standard terms are 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings and spare parts. Ask us to add it to your open gym layout.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/leg-ext.spec_paragraph: The leg arm pivots under the seat, so check that joint and the seat bolts at each service. The Leg Extension can be installed self-standing or grouted. Leave room in front of the seat for the leg arm's full swing, and keep the seat surface clean of dust and leaves.
flags: No spec rows, dimensions or warranty in the fact sheet.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/leg-lif.description: The Leg Lift Post is a combination station around a single grey post. The product image shows an orange seat with footrests, a large orange wheel on the post and a separate round stool with a textured top beside it. On the seated part, users lift and lower the legs against the footrests. The wheel can be turned for the arms and shoulders, and the stool gives a place to sit or step. It suits older adults in a park or society who want gentle exercise in one spot. Its orange parts are listed as Play Orange. Our team will send its size and warranty terms along with the quote. For the Leg Lift Post, we will confirm cover in writing; our standard terms are 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/leg-lif.spec_paragraph: The seat arm and the wheel both turn on bearings, so check them at each service. The post and stool can be installed self-standing or grouted. Place the stool so it does not sit in the path of the moving seat arm, and keep the area level.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/leg-pre.description: This three-in-one frame puts a leg press, an air walker and a seated twister together. One person pushes the footplates away on the leg press, another walks on the swinging pedals, and a third turns the hips on the seating station. Three users of different strength levels can train at once, which suits a society or park that has room for only one machine. The Leg Press Cum Fun Walker Cum Seating Twister comes in Play Orange and is part of our Fun Fitness range. We share its dimensions with the quote. Our usual cover for this kind of machine is 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings, and we will confirm it in your quote. Ask us for a layout.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/leg-pre.spec_paragraph: Three moving stations on one frame means three sets of bearings to check, so put this combination on a regular service schedule. The frame is usually grouted. Leave enough space around each station that the walker's swing and the leg press arm do not reach into each other's users.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/leg-pre.description: The Leg Press Cum Parallel Bar pairs a seated leg press with a set of parallel bars. On the leg press, the user sits and pushes the footplates away to work the thighs and hips. On the parallel bars, stronger users do dips and supported leg raises, while older users can hold them for balance during stretches. That spread of uses makes it a good single purchase for a school, college or society gym. Our Fun Fitness listing gives it in Play Orange. We confirm the footprint and the warranty on this unit in writing with your quote. We will confirm the Leg Press Cum Parallel Bar warranty with your quote; our standard terms are 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings. Send us your site size and we will mark its position.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/leg-pre.spec_paragraph: The parallel bars carry full body weight during dips, so the frame is best grouted. The leg press seat swings on pivots that need regular checks. Lay rubber flooring under the bars, where users step down, and keep the bars free of rust spots and loose fittings.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/leg-pre.description: The Leg Press Cum Pendulum joins two leg machines on one frame. The leg press is seated: the user pushes the footplates away and draws them back. The pendulum is standing: the user holds the handles and swings both legs together from side to side, which loosens the hips and waist. Together they give a lower-body routine that suits walkers, office staff and older residents. It comes in Play Orange as part of our Fun Fitness range for parks and societies. Its footprint has not been listed yet. Our standard warranty terms would cover the galvanised pipes on the Leg Press Cum Pendulum for 3 years and bearings for 1 year, and we will confirm this in writing. Ask us for a quote.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/leg-pre.spec_paragraph: Both stations move on bearings: the leg press arm and the pendulum step. Check and grease them at each service, and listen for knocking. The frame is installed self-standing or grouted. Leave room at the sides of the pendulum, because the step swings outward.
flags: No spec rows, dimensions or warranty in the fact sheet.

/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/leg-pre.description: On the Leg Press Cum Standing Twister, one user sits and pushes the footplates of the leg press while another stands on the twister and turns the hips from side to side. The two movements suit different people: the leg press for strength in the thighs, the twister for gentle waist mobility. It is a practical two-user machine for a society, a corporate campus or a walking track. The machine is finished in Play Orange. Size and warranty details are part of the quotation we send. For the Leg Press Cum Standing Twister, our sales team will confirm cover; standard terms are 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings. Share your site details for a layout.
/corecraft/fun-fitness-equipment/leg-pre.spec_paragraph: The twister platform turns on a bearing and the leg press arm on pivots, so both need regular checks. We install this pair self-standing or grouted. Position it so the twister user faces away from a walkway, and leave clear space in front of the footplates.
